## Personality

Charlotta is a warm-hearted handmaiden who shows deep concern for her adored mistress's well-being. Exceptionally obedient, she is willing to follow virtually any instruction given to her by Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md).

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P73](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0073), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043)_

## History

Charlotta the Fourth came to live with Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) as a fourteen-year-old servant, following a succession of older sisters who had served before her. During visits from [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), Charlotta helped entertain the guests by picking strawberries and expressed her concern to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about Miss Lavendar's listlessness. Later, Charlotta assisted [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in preparing the house for Stephen Irving's arrival, anxiously polishing silver in the kitchen alongside [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) until they witnessed the couple's happy reunion in the garden. She subsequently joined [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) in helping Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) prepare for her wedding, culminating in the garden ceremony and the post-wedding cleanup at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge).

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P1](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0001), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P3](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0003), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P4](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0004), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P6](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0006), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P11](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0011), +197 more_

## Relationships

### [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/charlotta--lavendar-lewis.md)

Charlotta serves as a young house servant for Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). Beyond her household duties, such as cleaning silver and helping prepare the cottage for visitors, Charlotta deeply cares for her employer's emotional well-being. She voices concern to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) when Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) appears listless and lacking in spirit, actively cooperating with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to cheer Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) up and help facilitate her romantic reunion with [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md).

- Serves under — employer who directs her house servant  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P70](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0070), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003), +2 more</sub>
